index.name: Commit-stall
index.one_liner: The agent investigates correctly, reaches the right conclusion, and never commits it.

index.name: The environment beats the prompt
index.one_liner: Changing what the agent *can* do works; telling it what it *should* do mostly doesn't.

index.name: Contained is not fixed
index.one_liner: A guard drives the incident rate to zero while the agent's judgment stays exactly as wrong.

index.name: Safety by inaction
index.one_liner: A 'did it avoid the bad action' metric is passed perfectly by an agent that does nothing.

index.name: Prior over policy
index.one_liner: The model's own sense of what's reasonable overrides the policy it just retrieved.

index.name: Framing over evidence
index.one_liner: The agent believes how the input was described instead of checking what the tools say.

index.name: Trust follows the channel, not the content
index.one_liner: The same instruction is refused in data and obeyed in a tool definition.

index.name: Ceremony is learned, prohibition is not
index.one_liner: Agents reliably obey 'do this first' and unreliably obey 'never do this'.

index.name: Directional bias
index.one_liner: Models don't err randomly — each errs in one direction, and the direction is a model property.

index.name: Competence does not transfer
index.one_liner: Being the best model on one agent task predicts almost nothing about the next.

index.name: Coordination-only failures
index.one_liner: Multi-agent systems fail in ways a single agent cannot, and orchestration amplifies rather than fixes.
